name: turbo_days_without_interval_wait
description: Tooling deviation (the harness lane's turbo clock, fc4_core::Turbo). The clock is frozen; the only thing that consumes time is an idle agent costing 1 ms per call, so one loop of OnTick costs 1 ms. Speed 0 (msPerDay 5000): without turbo no day can open within a tick. With turbo on (frame_ms 250) the day gate's ready is always true, so a new day opens on every loop pass once the day agent has finished the previous one: the first tick (turbo off) delivered the start day, so all 250 passes of the turbo tick open a day, one per millisecond. The budget is 250 at any speed. Switching turbo off restores the msPerDay wait and the §5.1 budget.

Burn.description: idle agent; makes simulated time pass

steps.note: turbo off: msPerDay 5000, no day in a 33 ms tick
t = 33 .. 283; a day at every pass
the turbo budget holds at speed 2 too
frame elapsed 40 -> budget 66 - 40 = 26; days wait for msPerDay 100 again
budgets 40, 26, 40, 26, 40 end at t = 521; the day due at 322 + 100 = 422 opens
